maddeler.e:
انصبنت (form VII)
# اِنْصَبَنْتُ (inṣabantu) /in.sˤa.ban.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# اِنْصَبَنْتَ (inṣabanta) /in.sˤa.ban.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# اِنْصَبَنْتِ (inṣabanti) /in.sˤa.ban.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# اِنْصَبَنَتْ (inṣabanat) /in.sˤa.ba.nat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
